doc.gh_min: **`gh` version.** The release scripts need `gh` 2.40.0 or newer. `gh run list --commit`, which the strict CI gate (`verify-release.mjs --ci-check --sha`) runs, first shipped in `gh` 2.40.0 (its release notes: "Filtering `run list` results by commit sha", cli/cli#8350); `gh` 2.39.2 has no such flag. Every other `gh` flag and JSON field the scripts use is present in the `gh` 2.40.0 source: `run list` with `--branch`, `--workflow`, `--status`, `--limit` and the fields `conclusion`, `headSha`, `headBranch`, `url`, `updatedAt`; `pr view` with the fields `number`, `state`, `mergeable`, `mergeStateStatus`, `statusCheckRollup`, `mergeCommit`, `headRefOid`; `pr create`; `pr merge --auto --merge`; `release create --verify-tag`; `release view --json tagName`; `auth status`. Each phase that calls `gh` (`start`, `prepare`, `publish`, `close-out`; `record` calls none) runs `gh --version` before any other `gh` call and stops with exit 14 `GH_UNAVAILABLE`, naming the installed and the required version, when `gh` is older or prints no version.
doc.lookup_retry: **A failed pull-request lookup.** `gh pr view` reports a missing pull request with its own message (`no pull requests found …`); any other failure is a failed lookup. The scripts try a failed lookup 3 times, 10 seconds apart (`AGC_RELEASE_GH_RETRY_SECONDS` sets the wait), then stop with exit 14 `GH_UNAVAILABLE` and `gh`'s error, never with `PR_CANNOT_MERGE`. Re-run the phase once `gh` answers.
